rules.source_title: Numeros Vision Classical Nadi Event System
rules.author: Numeros Vision Classical Archive
rules.exact_source_text: Broadly the combinations of career can be differentiated into three groups: a) 2,6,10,11 = 6,10,11 = 6,11 = 10,11 > 2,11 = 11; b) 2,6,10 = 6,10; c) 6 = 10 > 2.
rules.normalised_rule: Career success follows a 3-tier hierarchy: Group A (2,6,10,11 / 6,10,11 / 6,11 / 10,11 / 2,11 / 11) yields strongest growth and gains; Group B (2,6,10 / 6,10) yields moderate stability; Group C (6 / 10 / 2) yields weak or conditional outcomes.
dba_conditions: Active Dasha, Bhukti, or Antara lord must signify one or more Group A houses
transit_conditions: Transit of Sun, Jupiter, or Saturn linking with 2, 6, 10, or 11
exceptions: Presence of 5,8,12 in Sub-lord causes sudden blockage or reversal

rules.source_title: Numeros Vision Classical Nadi Event System
rules.author: Numeros Vision Classical Archive
rules.exact_source_text: Any of the three planets which signify 2,6,10,11 or 2,7,10,11 may/may not be from the DBA...
rules.normalised_rule: Independent enterprise and business require houses 2 (wealth), 7 (partners/public transactions), 10 (status/reputation), and 11 (profits/gains), with Mercury and Jupiter as primary significators.
transit_conditions: Jupiter or Mercury transiting favorable cusps

rules.source_title: Numeros Vision Classical Nadi Event System
rules.author: Numeros Vision Classical Archive
rules.exact_source_text: 5,8,12: This combination is worst for the Career & financial prospects in the business as well as in the job. It signifies suspensions, dismissals, scandals, insults & heavy loss of money.
rules.normalised_rule: Houses 5 (12th from 6th - job loss), 8 (insult/hindrance), and 12 (financial loss/resignation) indicate professional disruption or heavy losses.
transit_conditions: Separative planets aspecting or transiting 5, 8, or 12
exceptions: If 10 and 11 are also strongly signified, disruption is temporary and recovery follows

rules.author: Numeros Vision Classical Archive
rules.normalised_rule: Houses 5 (leaving previous post) and 9 (journey, transfer, new venture) signify job transfer or relocation.
exceptions: If accompanied by 2,6,11, it is a promotional transfer

rules.source_title: Numeros Vision Classical Nadi Event System
rules.author: Numeros Vision Classical Archive
rules.exact_source_text: Education - Maximum marks: 4,9,11; Lesser than above: 4,11/5,11; Competitive exam success: 4,9,11 / 6,11; Failure: 6,8,12.
rules.normalised_rule: High academic distinction is signified by 4 (foundational studies), 9 (higher wisdom/university), and 11 (success/honors). Competitive entrance success requires 6 (defeating competition) with 11.
dba_conditions: DBA operating 4,9,11 or 6,11 during examination period

rules.source_title: Numeros Vision Classical Nadi Event System
rules.author: Numeros Vision Classical Archive
rules.exact_source_text: Property Purchase: 4,11,12 Mars/Saturn. Purchase of Property on Loan: 4,11,12,6 Mars/Saturn.
rules.normalised_rule: Acquisition of real estate or land is governed by 4 (immovable asset), 11 (gain/possession), and 12 (capital investment/expenditure). Adding 6 indicates financing via mortgage/loan.
exceptions: Affliction by 3,8 indicates title defect or purchase cancellation

rules.source_title: Numeros Vision Classical Nadi Event System
rules.author: Numeros Vision Classical Archive
rules.normalised_rule: Overseas journeys and foreign residence require houses 3 (leaving residence/short journey), 9 (long journey/foreign shore), and 12 (foreign land/life away from home). Returning home requires 4 (residence) and 11.
exceptions: Absence of 12 indicates domestic rather than foreign travel

rules.source_title: Numeros Vision Classical Nadi Event System
rules.author: Numeros Vision Classical Archive
rules.normalised_rule: Marital union is governed by 2 (family addition), 7 (legal spouse/partner), and 11 (fulfillment of desires), signified by Venus. Negating houses 1, 6, 10 indicate separation, delay, or marital conflict.
exceptions: Sub-lord signifying 1,6,10 delays or prevents culmination

rules.source_title: Numeros Vision Classical Nadi Event System
rules.author: Numeros Vision Classical Archive
rules.normalised_rule: Legal disputes and courtroom conflicts operate through 6 (dispute/court), 8 (litigation stress), and 12 (confinement/legal costs). Victory or favorable resolution is promised when 6,11 or 10,11 dominate.
dba_conditions: DBA operating 6,8,12 triggers legal action; 6,11 or 10,11 brings resolution
transit_conditions: Saturn or Rahu transit over 6th cusp
exceptions: Presence of 11 ensures eventual favorable compromise or acquittal

rules.source_title: Numeros Vision Classical Nadi Event System
rules.author: Numeros Vision Classical Archive
rules.normalised_rule: Childbirth timing aligns with houses 2 (family growth), 5 (progeny/first child), and 11 (fulfillment). Any inquiry regarding child sex determination is strictly blocked under PCPNDT Act 1994.
exceptions: 1,4,10 causes temporary delay or medical assistance requirement
